title: angelonia procumbens
intro: Angelonia procumbens, commonly known as Angel's Trumpet or Angel's Tears, is a flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family native to tropical America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and acting as an antispasmodic and antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Angelonia procumbens include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
